unspecified_scores.reason: An in: query that is already impossible by kind or range now skips the collection-list loads, and the user sees the same empty result as before; I18 already says an impossible query loads no list (useFolderFiles.ts:292).

An in: naming a Smart Collection with no free text and more than 10,000 members now stops after the first page over the limit and still shows the same too-large state (inNameResolution.ts:172,181); spec step 9 names this early stop explicitly.

While the search window's typed query is impossible (e.g. two conflicting type: tokens), its jump rows, folder jumps and tag completions disappear until the conflict is removed (useLauncherRows.ts:47-59), which can look like suggestions broke mid-edit.

A -in: with a misspelt or other-drive collection name resolves no collection ids in drives.py:549-557 and silently excludes nothing, so the user sees the full unfiltered list with no notice that the name matched nothing.

specification_compliance: Spec step 9 (lines 213-216) scopes the 10,000 early stop to the member evaluation and the in: resolution; memberTarget.ts:111 and inNameResolution.ts:172 pass memberLimit, and smartCollectionEval.ts:142-148 implements the stop only when there is no free text.
For a query with no new token, filterQueryParam's output is unchanged (searchQuery.ts:1000-1021 leaves out null flags and empty new lists), which is consistent with I1's wire-level reading.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: AskScope (Ask page scope) now accepts kind 'epub', and its validation error messages gain a 'kinds:' / 'tags:' / 'folders:' / 'collections:' prefix through the shared apply_filter_normalisation.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: A user scoping Ask to EPUBs, or seeing a scope validation error, gets 'epub' accepted and a slightly different error wording; neither changes which files Ask reads in normal use.

regression_risks: Changing SearchFilter favorite/liked from false to null affects any future consumer that tests filter.favorite for truthiness rather than through filterQueryParam.
The shared apply_filter_normalisation couples Ask scope validation to search filter KINDS changes.
